heard: One day on Venus actually lasts longer than its year. A single rotation on its axis takes 243 Earth days. It holds the record for the solar system's slowest spin. Most other planets finish a full rotation in just hours. There's a catch. Venus actually spins in the opposite direction. Because of this backward rotation, the sun rises in the west. Even weirder, the atmosphere super rotates around the planet every four days. It's a bizarre world where a day lasts longer than its year.
